messages:
rachel: Quick thread 1: Diego is moving from Sr IC -> Eng Manager. Manager wants effective 2026-05-03. Need: payroll cutoff for May mid-month, how backpay is calculated, bonus/commission proration, equity timing, and any benefits/401k effects.
diego: Can we get backpay in next payroll if effective 5/3? Also want RSU grant to align with 5/3 if possible.
marta: Payroll cutoffs: May mid-month cutoff is 2026-05-05 COB. If HR job change posts by then, payroll will reflect new salary for that run. If missed, we can do an off-cycle (takes ~3 bus days).
marta: Backpay is a single lump-sum line labeled "Promotion Backpay". Calculation = prorated by days between effective date and pay periods already paid at old rate. We need signed Comp Change Request PDF + manager approval + employee ID + GL code.
diego: Thanks. What GL code format?
marta: Use prefix HR-OP- followed by 3 digits (e.g., HR-OP-117). Include it on the comp form.
payroll-bot: Reminder: attach signed Comp Change Request and manager approval email when emailing payroll@redwood.com. Off-cycle fee waived for promotions.
diego: Great. Bonus proration? I had deals in April paid under old target.
marta: Already-earned commissions/bonuses remain as paid under the plan. New target on 5/3 will prorate remaining days in the quarter. No retroactive clawbacks.
comp-committee-bot: Manager-level equity requires comp committee approval. Submit comp packet (current comp, proposed comp, business rationale, org snapshot) by 2026-05-04 to be on 5/05 agenda.
diego: If committee approves after 5/3, can grant date be 5/3?
comp-committee-bot: Grant date can match effective date if committee sign-off and paperwork are completed prior to grant issuance. If approval is later, issuance date will reflect approval date and grant may not be backdated.
rachel: Action items: 1) Diego to collect signed comp form and manager approval and send to payroll@redwood.com by 2026-05-04 COB to hit mid-month; 2) Marta/payroll to confirm GL code and confirm backpay calc; 3) Rachel to submit comp packet to comp committee by 2026-05-04 if equity desired; 4) Note: benefits/401k deductions change based on payroll deduction date, not effective date.
diego: I'll get the packet together and loop in manager. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
